description: This is a Java test class for the WordsSplitter component, containing unit tests for splitting words based on space keys and other behaviors.

classes.name: WordsSplitterTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the WordsSplitter functionality, including word splitting logic and edge cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test.

methods.name: typeWord
methods.description: Simulates typing a word with specified space key presses.

methods.name: splitToLists
methods.description: Splits the composed word into sublists based on the WordsSplitter logic.

methods.name: assertSplits
methods.description: Asserts that the split parts match expected strings.

methods.name: testExampleFromComment
methods.description: Tests splitting of a sample word with various space configurations.

methods.name: testGetEmptySubWordsWhenNoKeyIsNextToSpace
methods.description: Verifies behavior when no keys are next to space.

methods.name: testCanIterateOverWrappedProviders
methods.description: Checks iteration over subword providers and their properties.

methods.name: testDoesNotExceedMaxProvider
methods.description: Ensures the number of providers does not exceed maximum.

methods.name: testDoesNotExceedMaxSplits
methods.description: Verifies the maximum number of splits is respected.

methods.name: testDoesNotConsiderFirstCharacterAsSpace
methods.description: Checks that the first character is not considered a space.

methods.name: testConsiderLastCharacterAsSpace
methods.description: Checks behavior when the last character is marked as space.

methods.name: testReturnsEmptyResultIfInputTooShort
methods.description: Verifies that empty results are returned for very short inputs.

methods.name: testReturnsEmptyResultIfInputTooShort_2
methods.description: Another variation of input length test.

methods.name: testReturnsEmptyResultIfThereAreNoSpaces
methods.description: Checks that no splits are returned if there are no spaces.

methods.name: testReturnsEmptyResultIfThereAreNoSpacesEvenIfFirstIsSpace
methods.description: Verifies behavior when first key is space but no splits are possible.
